What we do

Two trades, one job well finished — whether it's patching up what's there or building something new.

Cosmetic repairs

Small jobs that make a big difference to how a place looks and feels — done tidily, without a big renovation bill.

  • Wall, plaster & timber patching
  • Door, cabinet & fixture fixes
  • Decking, fencing & timber rot repair
  • Touch-up painting & finishing

Metal fabrication & welding

Custom steel and aluminium work, built to fit — from a one-off repair to a made-to-measure piece.

  • Custom gates, rails & balustrades
  • Structural & repair welding
  • Brackets, frames & custom fittings
  • On-site & mobile welding
